dedupe_keys.name: corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco open data urgent technical rescue interventions by type month and provincial command fleet register and fuel use

description: This portal publishes the operational records of Italy's national fire and rescue service: how many urgent technical rescue interventions it carries out, of which kind, where and when, together with its vehicle fleet and fuel use. It is run by the Corpo Nazionale dei Vigili del Fuoco, the national fire corps, and its datasets were created in June 2025. Its 28 datasets split interventions by type, including gas leaks, water rescues and flooding, road, rail and aircraft accidents, workplace accidents, releases of pollutants, snow removal from roofs, stuck lifts and animal rescue, by place (homes, shops) and by macro-family, from 2019 to the current year. Each yearly file gives year, month, region, provincial command and intervention detail. Separate datasets describe the fleet over five years, vehicle use and fuel consumption by command. All files are free under the CC BY 4.0 licence and available to download as zipped CSV. Caveats: interventions are aggregated by month and province, not listed individually, response times are not included, and each intervention type is a separate dataset. Simulation uses: setting demand by intervention type and season for fire and rescue capacity models, and measuring surges during floods, snow or earthquakes. Related records: the Scottish fire statistics (data-sfrs-fire-stations-and-incident-statistics) and the German fire service statistics (data-dfv-german-fire-service-statistics) are comparable national sources.
